component.name: Ubuntu Clipboard
component.summary: Local clipboard history manager for Ubuntu and GNOME

description.p: Ubuntu Clipboard is a fast, lightweight, and native clipboard history manager designed for Ubuntu and GNOME on Wayland.

ul.li: Text and image clipboard history tracking
Compact cards with 3-line previews and aspect-ratio preserved thumbnails
Pin up to 10 favorite items with FIFO limitation on unpinned history
100% private and local SQLite storage with zero telemetry or network calls

description.p: Initial production release of Ubuntu Clipboard.
